name: wdr-newsource
description: WDR Serverless Application with optimized layers

scripts.build: npm run build:layers && npm run build:functions
scripts.build:layers: npm run build:layer:db && npm run build:layer:models && npm run build:layer:errors && npm run build:layer:pdf-utils && npm run build:layer:common-utils && npm run build:layer:external && npm run build:layer:exceljs
scripts.build:layer:db: cd layers/wdr-connect-db && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:layer:models: cd layers/wdr-models && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:layer:errors: cd layers/wdr-error-codes && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:layer:pdf-utils: cd layers/wdr-pdf-utils && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:layer:common-utils: cd layers/wdr-common-utils && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:layer:exceljs: cd layers/wdr-exceljs-layer && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:layer:external: cd layers/wdr-connect-external && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:functions: echo Functions will be built by SAM
scripts.deploy: sam build && npm run copy-layers && sam deploy
scripts.deploy:guided: sam build && npm run copy-layers && sam deploy --guided
scripts.copy-layers: npm run copy-layer:db && npm run copy-layer:models && npm run copy-layer:errors && npm run copy-layer:common-utils && npm run copy-layer:external && npm run copy-layer:exceljs
scripts.clean: npm run clean:layers && npm run clean:build
scripts.clean:layers: cd layers/wdr-connect-db && npm run clean && cd ../wdr-models && npm run clean && cd ../wdr-error-codes && npm run clean && cd ../wdr-common-utils && npm run clean && cd ../wdr-connect-external && npm run clean && cd ../wdr-exceljs-layer && npm run clean
scripts.copy-layers-linux: npm run copy-layer-linux:db && npm run copy-layer-linux:models && npm run copy-layer-linux:errors && npm run copy-layer-linux:common-utils && npm run copy-layer-linux:external && npm run copy-layer-linux:exceljs
